newsitem.title: USA: Chattem says Sunsource deal to add to EPS.
newsitem.headline: Chattem says Sunsource deal to add to EPS.

text.p: Chattem Inc said Thursday it expects its purchase of Sunsource International Inc will add incremental earnings of $0.20 to $0.30 per share in the first full year of operations.
However, for the balance of 1997, income from the brands will be only slightly accretive to earnings per share.
The company said it plans to provide heavy advertising and promotion support during the transition period.
The company, which said it completed the acquisition, did not disclose the details of purchase price.

It said the consideration paid at closing for the brands will be about one times sales The total consideration, including contingent payments over six years if earned, will approximate one and one-half times sales.
In order for these payments to be earned, annual sales would have to be maintained or increased. Additionally, the company will buy inventory and receivables from Sunsource.
The deal was financed by the expansion of the company's senior bank credit facility and the issuing to the seller 300,000 shares of its common stock.
